mentions.note: Belgian world record holder; in photo of Invitation 800m, White City 1956; won Invitation 800m, White City 1956

photos.c: The start of the Invitation 800m at the White City, Whitsun 1956. From the inside (right): Hewson the British Champ., John Davies, Sventgali of Hungary the European Champ., Mugosa of Hungary, Roger Moens the Belgian World Record holder, Currie ? cf Oxford, and two others.
